recentItems.title: Noah Lyles at the Youth Olympics! 🇺🇸 #Dakar2026
recentItems.description:
📺 Upcoming live streams from #Dakar2026 ➡️: https://oly.ch/3WlhhcN

Before making his senior Olympic debut at Tokyo 2020 or that fateful night at Paris 2024, where he etched his name in sporting history, Noah Lyles competed at the Youth Olympics in Nanjing 2014! The American took home gold in the 200m, clocking in a blistering time of 20.80. 💨
